messages.subject: First work session: Fri 9/28, 10AM-Noon, Wickson 2124
messages.body_plain:
Hello all,

Thanks for the enthusiastic response to the Davis R Users' Group!  By popular vote, we have selected Fridays at 10AM-Noon as our meeting time for this quarter.  Our first meeting will be in Wickson 2124 (the room at the top of the central staircase on the second floor).

Please come with your computers, R-related work, your questions and your willingness to help others!

Thanks,

Noam Ross
Graduate Group in Ecology
Department of Environmental Science and Policy
University of California at Davis
http://www.noamross.net/
twitter: @noamross

messages.subject: Free online course in R
messages.body_plain:
Hi folks,

Quick announcement:  If you are interested in learning R mostly from scratch, there's a free online course starting today at Coursera:  https://www.coursera.org/course/compdata

It's a 4-week course that says that it should take 3-5 hours a week.  If anyone takes it, let us know know how it is!

Noam

messages.subject: #Cross validation for spatial model question
messages.body_plain:
Sunday morning thin-plate splining!! What a life.

Feel free to tune out at this point if spatial stuff in R is NOT your cup of tea.

Anyway, I'm working on creating a spatial model for microclimate based on fine-resolution topography data - so far using the Tps() - fields package - and interpolate() - raster package - functions. I'm interested in trying to examine error in my model in as many ways as possible at this point - cross-validation and data partitioning are some ways to do this. I'm curious if the spatial folks might have "favorite" packages / functions out there for this sort of thing.

Any feedback much appreciated! :)
